meetings.title: On-site portfolio review
meetings.summary: Ashford University Endowment had a successful on-site portfolio review meeting with NEPC. The team discussed the current status of their mandates, including the American Funds Target Date Series and Capital Group Multi-Sector Income. Elizabeth O'Brien provided insights into the university's investment goals and risk tolerance. Ingrid Delgado facilitated the discussion and ensured all relevant parties were present.

decisions.text: Continue with due diligence on the American Funds Target Date Series mandate.

action_items.text: Prepare a detailed report on the Capital Group Multi-Sector Income mandate's performance and risks for presentation to the board next week.
Schedule a follow-up meeting with the investment committee to discuss the American Funds Target Date Series mandate after NEPC feedback is received.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Elizabeth O'Brien
transcript_excerpt.text: I appreciate the detailed presentation on our current mandates. We need to ensure we are aligned with our investment goals and risk tolerance.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Ingrid Delgado
transcript_excerpt.text: Absolutely, Elizabeth. Let's make sure all feedback from NEPC is thoroughly considered before making any decisions.
